name: stay-cost-brain
description: Tourist and hotel taxes from each authority's own pages: what a stay really adds on top of the room price, worked out night by night for your dates and guests, for 71 places in 19 countries (31 in the US) - plus a link to live hotel prices. Connects to Stay Cost Brain's hosted remote MCP server (https://staycostbrain.com/mcp). Read-only, no account, no sign-in.
